cases.note: canary '@' (0x40) != data byte 'X' (0x58): vulnerable version reads decoded[-1] in the mismatch check; patched version intercepts before the read.
canary 'X' (0x58) == data byte: vulnerable version passes the mismatch check and memmove writes before the buffer (corrupts decoded[-1]); patched version still intercepts.

after the delete byte 0x58 makes pos=-1 and passes (canary 'X' matches), 0x02 re-selects insert without changing dir (no pos reset), then 0x42='B' enters the insert branch with pos=-1: vulnerable version writes decoded[-1]='B'; patched version already returned at the delete-branch pos<0 check.
